pressure_hypothesis.title: Exact local retirement requires a persistent claim before target safety checks
pressure_hypothesis.subsystem: MNCS Environment retirement authority and Git adapter
pressure_hypothesis.basis: The baseline evaluator defers an exact branch retirement with writable repository rights and no claims, before the retirement adapter can inspect whether the branch is merged or checked out.
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: Admit explicit branch, registered-worktree, and metadata-prune operations from writable repository rights; keep exact target validation, applicable live-claim conflict checks, Git conditional updates, and separate delete escalation in the adapter and policy contracts.
pressure_hypothesis.recurrence: one reproduced policy class; recurrence across sessions is not established
not_measured: frequency of retirement work across sessions or repositories

whether this pressure explains other pickup, merge, or publish friction

measurement_limits: The reproduction evaluates the baseline policy with no claim records; it is not a replay of a persisted retirement event.
The prior interactive retirement deferral had no durable event identity in the campaign ledger.
This evidence does not establish that all authority or merge/publish failures share this cause.
